in_hebrew.name: תִּרְצָה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: תִּרְצָה (Thirza) – שְׁמוּעַ חָדָשׁ, 'שְׁמוּעַ בְּשִׁפְטֶיהָ' (1 Samuel 25:3). מְקוֹר נַחֲלָה (2 Chronicles 22:11). 'רְצוֹן' (Proverbs 19:22). 'אֱהָבָה' (1 Samuel 16:7). 'חָסְדִּי' (Psalm 138:8).

in_greek.name: Θηρσα
in_greek.long_meaning: Θηρσα (Thersa) – στίγμα θήρας (ἐπὶ τοῦ γένους, 1 Samuel 25:3). 'ἡ θήρα' (1 Samuel 25:3). 'ἡ θήραμα' (1 Samuel 25:3). 'ἡ θήρα' (1 Chronicles 22:11). 'ἡ θήρα' (Proverbs 19:22).

in_latin.name: Thirza
in_latin.long_meaning: Thirza – amor, voluntas, voluntaria. 'amor, voluntas, et voluntaria' (1 Samuel 25:3). 'voluntas' (1 Chronicles 22:11). 'voluntaria' (Proverbs 19:22).
